issues.claim: Nisonoff & Quadrel, 235 Old Bridge Tpke, town = South River
issues.problem: Wrong town. The firm's own website says it is "located on Old Bridge Turnpike in East Brunswick" - the 235 block of Old Bridge Tpke is East Brunswick (08816), not South River. Only third-party directories still show a South River address.
issues.fix: Remove from the South River zone (or re-label town as East Brunswick and drop it, since East Brunswick is outside this zone).

issues.claim: Girgis Family Medicine, 123 Main St, South River
issues.problem: Address contradicted by primary sources: Saint Peter's HealthCare System lists Linda Girgis, MD at 171 Main Street, Suite 4, South River 08882 with the same phone (732) 254-9494; a Wellpoint directory also gives 171 Main St. Only one insurer PDF shows 123 Main St.
issues.fix: Change address to 171 Main St, Suite 4 (note that 171 Main also houses Tabori dental and Dr. Gray DC) or mark address as disputed.

issues.claim: Envirochem Inc., 425 Whitehead Ave - category "Environmental services / laboratory"
issues.problem: Category is wrong. Directory listings describe Envirochem as a manufacturer of cleaning and sanitation products; a July 2025 EPA action concerned a chemical discharge from the facility to the South River. It is not an environmental testing lab or environmental consultancy.
issues.fix: Re-categorise as a cleaning-products manufacturer, or drop it - a manufacturer with an active EPA enforcement matter is a poor fit for a professional-services agent pitch.
